chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Hold the pick
exercises.purpose: Get a grip that is firm enough to not drop the pick, loose enough to stay relaxed.

params.grip: Lay the pick flat on the pad of your index finger, pointing across it. Drop your thumb on top.
params.pressure: light — the pick should twist if someone tugs it

exercises.coaching: Lay the pick across the side of your index finger, then put your thumb on top of it. Only about five millimetres of tip sticks out. Hold it like a crisp you do not want to snap. Too tight and your whole arm locks up; too loose and it flies across the room. You will drop it a few times today. Everyone does.

exercises.name: One string, ten times
exercises.purpose: Learn to hit one string cleanly with a down-pick.

params.cue: let the pick glide off the string, do not dig in

exercises.coaching: Pick the fat low E string ten times, downward only. Keep the movement small — it comes from the wrist, not the elbow. Aim for the same volume every time. Then move to the open A string and do ten more.

exercises.name: Down-strum all six
exercises.purpose: Brush all six strings evenly with the pick instead of the thumb.

params.action: slow down-strums across all six open strings
params.angle: tilt the pick very slightly so it glides rather than catches
params.cue: one smooth sweep, not six separate hits

exercises.coaching: Now strum down across all six open strings with the pick. Angle it a hair so it glides instead of snagging. You want one smooth sweep, not six separate clicks. Slow is fine — smooth is the goal.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: You have tuned up and made a sound. Now let's put a pick in your hand — it is the difference between a soft thud and a real, bright guitar tone.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Pick flat on the side of your index finger, thumb on top, five millimetres of tip showing. Firm but relaxed. If your knuckles go white, ease off.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Ten down-picks on the fat low E string. Small wrist motion, same volume each time. Then ten on the A string.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Strum all six open strings downward. Tilt the pick slightly so it glides. One sweep, not six clicks.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: Dropping the pick is normal in week one. Even volume and a smooth sweep are what we are after.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: That is the pick handled. Next lesson we take two chords you already know and make them talk to each other.

lesson.title: Holding the Pick
lesson.one_line_promise: Hold a pick properly and get a clean, even strum out of it.
objectives: Grip the pick with the thumb over the index finger, about 5mm of tip showing
Stay relaxed — no white knuckles, no locked wrist
Pick a single open string ten times at an even volume
Strum all six open strings in one smooth downward sweep
